scenarios.name: Create New Poem
scenarios.description: Verify that authenticated users can create a new poem with title and content (REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-7)

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials to obtain JWT token
steps.context: User must have an existing account

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/poems/ with title and content
steps.context: User is authenticated with valid JWT

steps.description: Confirm poem is created and returned with correct data
steps.context: API should return 201 Created with poem object

test_cases.input: POST /api/poems/ with {title: 'My First Poem', content: 'Roses are red\nViolets are blue', is_published: false}
test_cases.expected: 201 Created with poem object containing id, title, content, user_id, is_published=false, created_at, updated_at

test_cases.input: POST /api/poems/ with {title: 'Published Poem', content: 'The wind whispers softly', is_published: true}
test_cases.expected: 201 Created with poem object where is_published=true and share_token is generated

test_cases.input: POST /api/poems/ with multiline content containing special characters and line breaks
test_cases.expected: Line breaks and formatting preserved exactly as submitted (REQ-7)
401 Unauthorized error
422 Validation error - title is required
422 Validation error - content is required

scenarios.name: List User Poems
scenarios.description: Verify that authenticated users can view a list of their poems sorted by most recently modified (REQ-6)

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials to obtain JWT token
steps.context: User must have existing poems in the database

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/poems/
steps.context: User is authenticated with valid JWT

steps.description: Confirm returned list contains only user's poems in correct order
steps.context: List should be sorted by most recently modified first

test_cases.input: GET /api/poems/ for user with multiple poems
test_cases.expected: 200 OK with array of poem objects including title, status (draft/published), updated_at, sorted by updated_at descending

test_cases.input: GET /api/poems/ for user with no poems
test_cases.expected: 200 OK with empty array []
401 Unauthorized error

test_cases.input: GET /api/poems/ for User A should not return User B's poems
test_cases.expected: Only poems belonging to authenticated user are returned
200 OK with paginated results respecting skip and limit parameters

scenarios.name: Edit Existing Poem

test_cases.input: PATCH /api/poems/{id} with {content: 'New poem content\nWith line breaks'}
test_cases.expected: 200 OK with poem object reflecting updated content with preserved formatting

test_cases.input: PATCH /api/poems/{id} with {is_published: true} (changing draft to published)

200 OK with is_published=false, share_token may be retained or cleared

test_cases.input: PATCH /api/poems/{id} for poem owned by another user

404 Not Found error
401 Unauthorized error
